flags.why: The entry omits the usual noun meaning, epilepsy, which learners need to understand expressions such as bị động kinh.
flags.fix: noun | epilepsy; ex: Cậu bé bị động kinh từ nhỏ. = The boy has had epilepsy since he was little.

flags.why: Mộc meaning an official stamp is mainly Southern usage.
The rule or custom meaning is ordinary usage, including đã thành lệ and theo lệ thường, rather than literary ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-l%E1%BB%87)).
Learners are more likely to encounter lệ meaning rule or custom in everyday Vietnamese than the literary meaning tears.
